source.quote: This guide lists the code changes for moving from API version `2023-06-01` to `2026-10-21`.

tasks.reasoning:
The repo uses the Python `anthropic` SDK with an open-ended requirement `>=0.40.0` in requirements.txt. Older SDKs keep sending 2023-06-01. The new SDK majors (Python v1.0 is referenced in the changelog) are expected to send 2026-10-21 by default. A fresh install or rebuild could therefore resolve to the v1 major without anyone choosing to upgrade. Every Claude call in the repo passes `temperature`, so all three call sites would start failing with 400s. That would break the whole Claude integration and the module2 confidence and validation pipeline. The migration agent should choose one of two options. Option 1: pin the SDK below the v1 major (e.g. `anthropic>=0.40.0,<1.0.0`) as a stopgap. Option 2: deliberately move to the v1 SDK / 2026-10-21 and remove `temperature` from all three calls. Also check whether any call site places document blocks in assistant messages or citations in user messages; the scan did not read message contents. Uncertain: the exact Python v1 release date and whether it defaults to 2026-10-21. Confirm in the Python SDK changelog.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- anthropic:2026-10-21-sampling-params-removed (field-removed): In API version 2026-10-21, temperature, top_p and top_k in Messages and Batch requests return 400. The 400 on temperature, top_p and top_k only applies once requests carry anthropic-version 2026-10-21. The same move that adopts or guards against the new version must remove `temperature` from all three messages.create calls.
  Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21.md
  "In `2026-10-21`, a request that sends `temperature`, `top_p`, or `top_k` returns a 400 error, even at the parameter’s default value."

## New Claude API version 2026-10-21 (anthropic-version header); SDKs older than the new majors keep sending 2023-06-01 [Needs review]

### Change

Removed `temperature` from all three Anthropic messages.create calls (claude_client.py, confidence_index.py, multipass_validator.py). Bumped requirements.txt to `anthropic>=1.0.0`. Replaced `response.content[0].text` with a join over text blocks in confidence_index and multipass_validator. Added tests/test_anthropic_version.py, which drives the real call sites against a mocked httpx transport. It asserts that no sampling params are sent and that the `anthropic-version` header is 2026-10-21.

Files touched:
- `backend/integrations/claude_client.py`
- `backend/pipeline/module2/confidence_index.py`
- `backend/pipeline/module2/multipass_validator.py`
- `requirements.txt`
- `tests/test_anthropic_version.py`

### Why

API version 2026-10-21 (the default in the new SDK majors) returns 400 when a request sends temperature, top_p or top_k. All three calls sent `temperature`, and the open-ended `anthropic>=0.40.0` requirement could resolve to the new major on a fresh install.

> This guide lists the code changes for moving from API version `2023-06-01` to `2026-10-21`.

Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| anthropic-version-proof | fail (1) | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Checks added by the agent (they count toward proof; check that each command really tests the change):
- anthropic-version-proof, added by the agent: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_anthropic_version.py -q` (fail (1) → pass)

Provider validators: none run.

Where checks ran: Docker container python:3.12-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- No live API call was made.
- Which SDK release first defaults to 2026-10-21 was not confirmed. The sandbox installed anthropic 2.4.0 and the test saw the 2026-10-21 header from it.
- The baseline failure of the proof check only means the test file did not exist. It does not show the old code sent temperature.
- Model ids (claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-7) were left unchanged. I did not check them for deprecation.
- Message contents were checked: call sites 1 and 2 send plain text only, and call site 3 sends image and text blocks in user turns only. No document blocks in assistant messages and no citations were found.
- I did not run pytest across the whole repo, because the repo has no other tests.
- pytest is not in requirements.txt. I installed it in the sandbox by hand.
- The agent wrote no test of this change and gave no reason why none can be written.
- No provider validator was run.

### Behaviour changes

- The `temperature` argument of call_claude_json is now accepted but ignored. The per-pass TEMPERATURE_SCHEDULE in multipass_validator is now dead for Claude, so multipass variants differ only by their prompts.
- requirements.txt floor is now anthropic>=1.0.0 (was >=0.40.0).
- Response text is now read by joining all text blocks instead of reading content[0].

---

review.summary: The diff covers all three named call sites. It drops `temperature` from each `messages.create` and makes text extraction safe for responses whose content is not only text. The SDK floor moves to `anthropic>=1.0.0`, and the mock-transport tests prove the header is `2026-10-21` and that no sampling params are sent. But removing `temperature` does more than the API change forces. `multipass_validator.py` builds its pass diversity on `TEMPERATURE_SCHEDULE = [0.0, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0]`, and the confidence index depends on that spread. After this change every pass runs at the server default, so the passes differ only by prompt variant and the CI scores mean something different. The schedule is still computed and logged, so the logs now report temperatures that are never sent. `call_claude_json` and the semantic YES/NO check also lose their explicit `temperature=0.0` determinism. I could not confirm from memory that 2026-10-21 rejects temperature/top_p/top_k, or that `anthropic` 1.x is the major that sends the new header; check the quoted migration guide and the SDK's version constant. needs-review is the right grade: the checks are offline mocks and prove nothing about live behaviour or output quality.

concerns.issue: Removing `temperature=temperature` (around line 116) silently breaks the multi-pass design. `TEMPERATURE_SCHEDULE` is still computed in `run_single_pass` and printed in `run_multipass_validation` ('temp=...'), but it no longer affects the request. The confidence index (run_count/n_passes) now measures agreement between prompt variants at the default temperature, not across a temperature spread. This needs an explicit product decision, such as a different diversity mechanism or dropping the schedule, plus updated logs.

`call_claude_json` still accepts `temperature: float = 0.0` (line ~41) but ignores it. The new test even passes `temperature=0.7`. Callers believe they control sampling. Remove or deprecate the parameter, or at least warn when it is set, so the API stays honest.

The docstring of `_are_same_discrepancy` still says 'Uses temperature=0.0 for deterministic binary decision'. Without temperature the YES/NO grouping may be less stable between runs, which feeds straight into run_count. Update the docstring and consider whether grouping should stay deterministic.

`anthropic>=1.0.0` has no upper bound, and I could not confirm it is the major that defaults to `anthropic-version: 2026-10-21`. Check the SDK's changelog or default-headers constant. A new major may also change other surfaces this code uses: `APIError`, `RateLimitError`, `with_options`, and the `.type`/`.text` attributes on content blocks.

The test tries `import httpx2 as httpx` before `httpx`. I don't recognise `httpx2`; confirm which HTTP client the new SDK major expects for `http_client=`. The tests are mock-only, so they don't show whether the live API accepts these requests, including the image payload in multipass, or whether outputs still parse.
The multipass test passes no images (`[]`), so the image/base64 content path and `_resize_image_if_needed` are never exercised under the new SDK.

checkFirst: Confirm in the quoted migration guide (migration-2026-10-21.md) that temperature/top_p/top_k are rejected outright, not just deprecated or restricted to some models.
Decide with the owner how multi-pass diversity should work now that `TEMPERATURE_SCHEDULE` has no effect, and fix the misleading 'temp=' log in `run_multipass_validation`.
Check the anthropic SDK 1.x changelog or source to confirm it sends `anthropic-version: 2026-10-21` by default, and consider pinning `<2`.
Run one live request per call site against the new version, including an image request for multipass.

### Change

No code, config or env default in the repo names claude-sonnet-4-5 or claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929. Models are claude-sonnet-4-6 (MODULE1/3 default, module2 fallbacks) and claude-opus-4-7. The only matches were in the vendored backend/.venv site-packages. No edits made.

No files changed.

### Why

The retiring model ID is not used, so the Nov 30, 2026 retirement does not affect this repo.

> | November 30, 2026 | `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` | `claude-sonnet-5-5` |

Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations.md

### Proof

No checks were run.

New failures: 0

Provider validators: none run.

Where checks ran: Docker container python:3.12-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- Deployed MODULE1_MODEL/MODULE2_MODEL/MODULE3_MODEL env overrides could still name claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929; they are not visible in the repo.
- Did not check whether claude-sonnet-4-6 or claude-opus-4-7 have their own retirement dates, and did not check whether they accept the temperature parameter that the call sites send.
- No checks were run.

### Behaviour changes

None intended.
